semanticContract.scope: Labels, native geometry, groups, and three optical/control directed connectors. Material topology is reviewed separately.

rounds.semanticReview: Continuous main channel, opposing oil streams, droplets, on-chip meander, detection preceding branch, and detector-controller-electrode connections are visible. Main physical topology has no observed missing link.

observations: Saved PDF font resources use LiberationSans and LiberationSans-Bold.
Assay thread and two oil feeds meet at the flow-focusing site before discrete droplets.
Continuous meander joins both generation and detection without a material gap.
Detector is upstream of the sorting electrode and Y branch.
Dot-marked droplets pass to the F ≥ θ collected outlet; open droplets pass to F < θ waste.
Optical readout reaches detector, dashed F signal reaches controller, and dashed trigger reaches electrode.
All three control connector endpoints coincide with visible native object boundaries.
No unintended label clipping or overlap observed at the full or publication-width render.
Filled centers, open centers and dashed lines retain their meanings in reduced grayscale.
rounds.conclusion: No further visible defect requiring revision was identified. Reduced grayscale is a structural check, not a guarantee of small-text readability at arbitrary print sizes.

renderProvenance.pipeline: Saved PPTX -> bundled LibreOffice PDF -> bundled Poppler PNG

unsupportedOperations.operation: Automatic semantic interpretation of the custom fluid-channel paths
unsupportedOperations.handling: Recorded complete material relations before drawing and traced them in the saved render.
No claim of app-level edit validation; native OOXML objects and groups were verified.
Used inspected U-Net reference-card source only for spatial connection principles; source limitation retained.

limitations: Hypothetical methodology, not measured sorting evidence.
Geometry, droplet counts and fluorescence glyphs are schematic.
Channel dimensions, rates, delay duration, physical signals, biology, electrode details and trigger timing remain unspecified.
The figure does not validate timing, electrical actuation or sorting performance.
The editable custom paths require node editing in PowerPoint; their physical channel topology does not automatically reroute after arbitrary edits.
Native PowerPoint rendering and interactive editing were not tested.
PDF fonts were verified in the bundled LibreOffice output; another viewer may render differently.
Publication-width review used a 96 dpi pixel equivalent and known file dimensions, not a calibrated physical print.

koreanSummary: 177.8 mm 폭의 단일 슬라이드 도식을 완성했습니다. 물질 흐름과 검출·제어·전극 관계를 편집 가능한 도형으로 구성했으며, 저장 PPTX를 렌더링해 2회 검토했습니다. 액적 표시와 채널 형상은 가상 예시이고, 실제 분류 성능이나 PowerPoint 직접 편집 검증은 주장하지 않습니다.
